intent: Sync controlled Field.Control value changes into dirty, filled, and validity state while avoiding duplicate validation of user keystrokes. Also honor cancellation and clear focused state when the control unmounts or becomes disabled while focused.

findings.title: Controlled canceled changes still validate
findings.suggested_fix: Track cancellation from the controlled onChange callback and suppress the matching controlled-value echo in useValueChanged; retain normal synchronization for later programmatic prop changes.
findings.why_it_matters: A controlled consumer that updates its value and calls details.cancel() still reaches useValueChanged, which clears errors, changes dirty and filled state, and validates the new value. That contradicts the event detail contract that cancel stops Base UI from handling the event; preserve normal prop synchronization while suppressing the canceled event's echo.
evidence: packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx:105-114 -- useValueChanged handles changed serializedValue by clearing errors, updating dirty/filled, and calling validation.change.
packages/react/src/internals/createBaseUIEventDetails.ts: the cancel() contract says it cancels Base UI from handling the event.

findings.title: Unmount leaves focused state latched
findings.suggested_fix: Reset focused state in an effect cleanup and when the control becomes disabled, so removing or disabling a focused control clears the root state even when no blur event fires.
findings.why_it_matters: If a focused Field.Control is conditionally unmounted while Field.Root remains mounted, onBlur does not run and the root keeps data-focused set. The PR body says unmounting or disabling a focused control no longer latches that state, but this code still only resets it in onBlur.
evidence: packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx:161-164 -- only onBlur sets focused false; the component has no unmount cleanup for focused state.
